articles.title: A 236-Million-Year-Old Fossil May Have Just Rewritten the Story of Mammal Birth
articles.summary: Scientists found a tiny growth line in a 236-million-year-old fossil that suggests live birth happened way earlier than we thought. It's like finding a secret clue from the age of dinosaurs!

articles.title: Space Force Pays Rocket Lab $397 Million to Build 'Flatellites' That Track Threats
articles.summary: Rocket Lab is building flat satellites for the Space Force to track enemy planes. They're called 'Flatellites' and they'll launch on a new rocket!

articles.title: Can Venus Cast a Shadow? Here's How to See It for Yourself
articles.summary: Venus can cast a shadow, but you need a dark sky and a white card. Here's how to catch this rare sight in September.
